Datasets

The six course tables. Each help page says what one row is, the units, the source, the vintage and what was changed.

weo
World Economic Outlook, October 2026: the tidy country panel
weo_mini
A mini table you can see whole: twelve rows of weo
weo_full
World Economic Outlook, October 2026: every indicator, for every country
weo_indicators
What you can ask of the World Economic Outlook: its 44 indicators
weo_groups
World Economic Outlook, October 2026: the two big groups, as the IMF lays them out
wb_groups
The World Bank's country groups: region, income level and lending type
